claims.claim_ar: النهي «وَلَا تَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا بِآيَاتِ اللَّهِ» يفيد تقييد النهي بحصر المنع بمن فعل محدّد (من كذّب بآيات الله)، أي أن التحذير ليس عاماً بل مقصور على هذه الصفة.
claims.claim_en: The prohibition 'and do not be of those who denied the signs of Allah' conveys restriction: the warning is limited to those who possess the specified attribute (those who denied God's signs), not a wholly general prohibition.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting source chunk contains a general statement ('إفادة الحصر') about expressing restriction but does not comment on this specific verse; claim therefore plausible but should be confirmed with targeted commentary on this ayah.
claims.rhetorical_effect: narrows the moral/ethical target of the admonition, focusing the listener's avoidance on a clearly identified blameworthy group

claims.source_quote_ar: وذكر الظاهر بصيغة زائدة مناسبة للمصدر
claims.claim_ar: تكرار حرف الجر «مِنَ» (مِنَ الَّذِينَ ... فَتَكُونَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِينَ) يعمل تكراراً بلاغياً يؤكد الربط والتقابل بين الانتماء إلى فئة المنكرين والوقوع في الخسران.
claims.claim_en: The repetition of the preposition 'min' (mim) (min alladhina ... fa-takuna min al-khasireen) constitutes a rhetorical repetition that emphasizes the link/parallelism between belonging to the deniers and becoming among the losers.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source fragment notes redundancy/explicit mention ('وذكر الظاهر بصيغة زائدة') in general rhetorical practice, but it is a generic remark and not a targeted analysis of the exact recurrence of «مِنَ» here; functional particles have limited 'root' status and the rhetorical import needs corroboration from focused tafsir/بلاغة on this verse.
claims.rhetorical_effect: intensifies the psychological connection between the reproved action and its consequence, making the causal link more vivid

claims.claim_ar: الفعل المنهي «تَكُونَنَّ» مستخدم مع نون التوكيد (نَّ) للدلالة على قوة التحذير والتشديد — أسلوب إنشائي يؤكد الأمر النهي ويزيد وقع النص على المخاطب.
claims.claim_en: The prohibitive verb 'takunanna' with the emphatic nun (نّ) functions as a performative construction that intensifies the prohibition — an injunctive/illocutionary device that heightens the admonitory force.
claims.needs_review_reason: The supporting quote ('وفي هذا النوع البليغ نكتتان') is a general observation about rhetorical niceties; a direct classical commentary on the emphatic nun in this specific verb in this verse would better substantiate the claim.
claims.rhetorical_effect: increases urgency and moral pressure on the addressee to avoid the condemned behaviour
